the-board-can-be-restored-after-an-sdr-t.rationale: Two matching complete flash reads and final post-trial restore/readback match; original GPIO firmware is running. Actual physical power-cycle proof remains open.

the-spectrum-reveals-controlled-24ghz-si.next: Establish repeatable source-on/off responses and calibrated filter/gain/tuning references.
the-spectrum-reveals-controlled-24ghz-si.rationale: Five owned BLE packets prove narrow known-signal reception. Three-cycle RF repeatability, calibrated filtering/gain and extended tuning references remain open.

the-receiver-can-observe-and-decode-shor.next: Obtain an actual recorded source counter independent of ESP decoding, then run the three predeclared receiver trials.
the-receiver-can-observe-and-decode-shor.rationale: Five complete owned BLE packets decode with exact data and protected-PDU CRC. The physical Bluetooth monitor verifies accepted settings; three finite source-only trials accepted commands but reported no completed-event count. Capture hit/miss reliability remains open.

the-two-receivers-have-a-measured-divisi.next: Inspect the RTL antenna and physically inventory available conversion/reference equipment.
